hero numbers break from mono for contrast
primary status hue: health, CPU, battery
disk progress + Return to Earth button

tokens.value: dense ~24-28px-class rows, icon + bold name + dimmed process-id + numeric cols + trailing kebab

patterns.key_values: 4x2 stat cards; header(tinted glyph + tracked-uppercase mono label + trailing status chip) -> bold hero figure+unit -> mono metadata line -> inline viz (bar-array/area/sparkline/progress/sphere); gaps ~12-16px-class
process monitor; sortable cols NAME(50)/PID/CPU/PWR/MEM; tracked-uppercase headers w/ sort carets; dense rows; app-icon + bold name + dimmed process-id; trailing per-row kebab
centred tab group (mole glyph in rounded container + 5 text tabs Clean/Apps/Optimize/Analyze/Status); white-pill active state; toolbar-as-tab-bar (non-native)
Clean hero: centred stack — 3D Earth globe -> bold figure 86.4 GB -> dimmed mono caption -> single primary capsule button 'Return to Earth'

signature_moves: Monospace-everywhere telemetry: whole UI in a coding monospace with tracked-uppercase section headers; only hero figures break to bold proportional — the app's htop/instrument-panel character in one decision (also the source of its non-native tells and contrast risk)

Thematic celestial visualizations: photoreal 3D Earth for Clean, plasma sun sphere for Health, per-surface gradient sky + horizon mountains, playful copy ('Return to Earth') — reframes distrusted system-cleaner category as a warm calm cosmos
Per-surface tinted gradient canvas instead of a flat neutral window background (warm espresso vs navy dusk per tab)
defects: Contrast Dilution — tertiary monospace metadata ~30-40% opacity on dark gradient likely <4.5:1 (process-ids, footnotes)
Tracked-uppercase headers (non-native tell) — card + column headers UPPERCASE tracked mono; top table/sidebar authenticity tell
Toolbar-is-a-tab-bar — segmented text nav in the toolbar with white-pill selection; 'a toolbar is not a tab bar'
Non-accent / unbound selection — active tab white pill; no single system-accent binding selection+focus+primary
Kebab (dot-dot-dot) row menus — web/Electron tell for row actions
Target Starvation (borderline) — sub-24px per-row kebab + sort carets

aesthetic.direction: Terminal/hacker family (monospace-everywhere, console/log aesthetic, green accent) remixed with Organic/soft surface (warm tinted gradients, celestial imagery) — a warm-console instrument panel

psychology: Aesthetic-Usability Effect — celestial visuals + polish buy perceived trust/usability for a category users fear (system cleaners); warmth lowers the guard
Hierarchy via de-emphasis / label-value — bold hero figures dominate, tracked-mono labels whisper: value outranks label on every stat tile (correct)
Von Restorff / signal detection — single prominent 'Return to Earth' primary in Clean; in Status the white tab pill is the loudest mark
Miller/Cowan chunking — 8 stat cards in a 4x2 domain-chunked grid; 8>5-7 but this is a monitoring/browse surface not a decision point, so density is a feature (choice-overload calibration)

Jakob's Law (violated, genre-excused) — monospace-everywhere + tracked headers + tab-in-toolbar depart from trained macOS expectations, raising first-run unfamiliarity, though consistent with the htop/iStat mental model of its target audience
notes: Only two inputs available: a 1200x630 non-retina marketing OG composite (cover.png) containing two overlapping dark-mode app windows, plus icon.png (a flat 2-tone brand mark, not a Liquid-Glass app-icon render). NO standalone shot-* files. Both app windows are scaled ~0.5x mockups and partly cropped, so ALL metrics are (estimated) with wide ranges and NO absolute pt value is recoverable — do not promote any absolute number. Lineage is genuinely ambiguous: marketing claims 'native Mac utility', chrome/traffic-lights/arrow-cursor are genuine, density is pro-native, but the design language is so custom (monospace body, tracked-uppercase headers, white-pill tab selection, kebab menus, full-window gradients) that it departs from AppKit grammar on ~half the native-tells audit. Classified native/low-confidence; web-Electron not excludable from a still. Per the lineage/era gate, this custom evidence must NOT feed macOS native canon — timeless rules only (grid, hierarchy, label-value). No light-mode, settings, onboarding, or inspector surfaces seen. Icon not digested to a file (Workflow A only, per task).
